content_sections.heading: NHSRC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NHSRC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NHSRC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate - Child Health Division: Graduate in any discipline with proficiency in data management. At least 5-8 years experience at National level in consolidating, analyzing and monitoring the RCH programme. Knowledge & proficiency in computer applications particularly MS office. Project Assistant (RBSK): Graduate in any discipline. At least 5 years of experience in health sector preferably under NHM at National/State level. Knowledge & proficiency in computer applications particularly MS office.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 60 years for all posts. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHSRC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving online applications for the NHSRC Project Associate / Project Assistant posts is 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available in the NHSRC Recruitment 2026 are Project Associate - Child Health Division and Project Assistant (RBSK). These positions are contractual and based in Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NHSRC Recruitment 2026 is online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website of the National Health Systems Resource Centre.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NHSRC Project Associate / Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the NHSRC Project Associate / Project Assistant posts is 60 years. There is no minimum age specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Associate / Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate - Child Health Division ranges from Rs.55,000/- to Rs.70,000/- per month, and for Project Assistant (RBSK), it is Rs.30,000/- to Rs.60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline. Specific experience requirements include 5-8 years in RCH programme monitoring for Project Associate and 5 years in the health sector under NHM for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NHSRC Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NHSRC Project Associate / Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NHSRC Project Associate / Project Assistant posts primarily involves a Written Test. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in this test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for NHSRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification for NHSRC Recruitment 2026 on the official website of the National Health Systems Resource Centre (nhsrcindia.org). A direct link is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
